item.title: Top 4 Methods to Solve: Wrapping a C Library in Python
item.description:
Top 4 Methods to Solve: Wrapping a C Library in Python

If you’re looking to integrate a C library into your Python application but only require specific functions and data types, you have several options to consider. This post will guide you through the top methods to effectively wrap a C library using Python, particularly focusing on ctypes, Cython, cffi, and SWIG. Here, we’ll explore practical examples, alternatives, and insights into each method.
